jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  
  

**About the Role & Team**
-------------------------

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). At Disney, you’ll help inspire magic by enabling our teams to push the limits of entertainment and create innovative built environments.

The Project Coordinator will play a critical support role in the team’s internal programs, including our internship program, training compliance, and onboarding efforts while also supporting planning, organization, and execution of construction projects from inception to completion.

This position reports to the Sr Manager, Programs.

**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

* Coordinate the intern, onboarding, and training programs, including committee meetings, logistics, compliance tracking, and reporting.
* Support Project Managers with project administration, including invoicing, contracts, change orders, budgets, and close-out documents.
* Track deliverables and open items, following up with team members, partners, and vendors.
* Participate in project and punch walks and lead meetings as needed to keep projects moving.
* Identify project risks and monitor safety and regulatory compliance.
* Facilitate communication among team members, clients, vendors, and partners, and resolve issues promptly.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**
-------------------------------------

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and build relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and the capacity to handle challenges in a dynamic environment.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining a positive and proactive attitude.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
* Ability to lead meetings, develop agendas, and coordinate logistics for events and committees.
* Highly adaptable, and thrive in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Education: 2 years of college education
* Proven experience as a Project Coordinator in the construction industry, with a track record of successful project delivery; procurement, contract administration, or invoicing experience a plus.
* Proficiency in project management software and tools for scheduling and reporting (e.g., Microsoft Project, PMWeb, Excel).

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities and special extras that only Disney can provide. Learn more about our benefits and perks at https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits.

A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

  

This position is with Walt Disney Parks and Resorts U.S., Inc., which is part of a business we call Disneyland Resort.

Position Summary
  
  
The Contracts Coordinator provides the administrative, systems, documentation, and coordination infrastructure that supports an efficient and sustainable contract lifecycle. The Coordinator monitors contract intake, maintains contract records and CLM data, tracks deadlines and required documents, supports review and execution workflows, prepares routine reports, and helps ensure that executed agreements and related records are accurate, complete, and accessible. The Coordinator works closely with the Contracts Manager, VP of Grants, Contracts & Implementation, departmental SMEs, and the Grants & Contracts Project Coordinator to maintain reliable workflows, records, and operational follow-through.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Contract Administration & Records
  
  
Maintain organized, accurate, standardized, user-friendly, and searchable contract files and records.
  
  
Maintain contract management system/CLM records, including tags, metadata, expiration dates, renewal dates, ownership fields, document links, and contract status information.
  
  
Electronically file, tag, and link executed contracts, amendments, BAAs, W-9s, insurance certificates, signature pages, and other required documentation.
  
  
Ensure contract documentation is complete and readily accessible for internal use, audits, reporting, and operational needs.
  
  
File and organize agreements and supporting documents received by email, ensuring documents are stored in the appropriate contract record.
  
  
Update Contract Information Forms and reconcile submitted information with executed agreements to ensure records reflect the most current terms and obligations.
  
  
Monitor routine contract deadlines, expirations, and required follow-up; issue reminders and escalate overdue items to the Contracts Manager.
  
  
Contract Intake, Review & Stakeholder Support
  
  
Provide basic intake and routing support for the Contracts and Legal Agreements inboxes and new/amended/renewal contract requests.
  
  
Monitor the Contracts and Legal Agreements inboxes and log new agreements, amendments, renewals, and BAAs.
  
  
Maintain the contract intake and status tracker, ensuring requests are recorded accurately and updated as they move through review and execution.
  
  
Track outstanding reviews, approvals, signatures, renewals, and required documents; send routine follow-ups and escalate overdue items to the Contracts Manager.
  
  
Prepare signature packets, monitor execution, and distribute final executed agreements to appropriate internal stakeholders.
  
  
Conduct an initial review of contract documents and flag terms, provisions, missing information, or documentation requirements that may need review by the Contracts Manager or appropriate SME.
  
  
Coordinate collection of required internal documents, approvals, and supporting materials for contract review and execution.
  
  
Respond to routine staff questions regarding contract records, status, process steps, and documentation requirements; route substantive legal, compliance, financial, or operational questions to the Contracts Manager.
  
  
Support routine communications with funders and vendors as directed by the Contracts Manager.
  
  
Work with appropriate Budget Managers and other SMEs to obtain information needed for contract amendments and related processing.
  
  
Systems, Reporting & Process Support
  
  
Maintain data integrity within the contract management system and support ongoing cleanup, standardization, and quality assurance.
  
  
Prepare routine contract reports and data for the Contracts Manager, VP, Fiscal, Compliance, IT, program leadership, and other departments as needed.
  
  
Maintain the intranet program directory and related contract information, including Sites / Power BI information as assigned.

Identify recurring administrative issues, gaps, or inefficiencies and recommend workflow improvements to the Contracts Manager.
  
  
Participate in implementation, testing, maintenance, and continuous improvement of contract management tools and related technologies.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, with occasional evenings and weekends for scheduled events  
**Work Setting:** On-site, with travel to event venues as required

A successful event takes careful preparation, good communication and someone who can keep track of the details while plans are coming together. We are hiring an Event Coordinator in Los Angeles to support the planning and delivery of business events, private functions and organized gatherings.

You will work with clients, vendors, venues and internal team members to coordinate arrangements from the early planning stages through event day. The role suits someone who enjoys organizing several tasks at once, follows up on commitments and can respond calmly when schedules or requirements change.

Responsibilities

* Assist with event planning by gathering requirements, confirming objectives and preparing schedules for upcoming functions.
* Coordinate venue arrangements, room layouts, equipment, catering, signage and other event-related requirements.
* Communicate with vendors and service providers to confirm bookings, delivery times, setup instructions and agreed services.
* Maintain event calendars, planning documents, contact lists and task trackers to keep arrangements organized.
* Prepare event timelines and distribute relevant information to staff, suppliers and other participants.
* Track expenses, process purchase requests and maintain records of event-related costs against approved budgets.
* Coordinate registration details, guest lists, invitations and attendee communications where required.
* Visit venues before events to review setup arrangements and identify any outstanding requirements.
* Assist with event-day operations, including supplier arrivals, setup checks, schedule coordination and last-minute adjustments.
* Respond to questions from clients and attendees, directing requests to the appropriate team members.
* Collect feedback after events and help prepare notes on what went well and what could be improved.

Experience And Skills

We are looking for an organized and dependable person who can manage practical arrangements while keeping communication clear. Previous experience in event coordination, hospitality, administration or customer-facing operations would be useful.

The role will benefit from someone who has:

* Good planning skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence communicating with vendors, clients and different internal departments.
* Strong attention to detail when handling schedules, guest information and event documentation.
* The ability to adjust plans when requirements change or unexpected issues arise.
* Basic budget tracking and record-keeping skills.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

Experience with event planning software, registration platforms or vendor coordination is an advantage. A qualification in Event Management, Hospitality, Communications or Business is welcome, but practical experience and strong organizational ability are also valued.

A Varied Working Environment

The Event Coordinator will divide time between planning tasks, supplier communication, meetings and event preparation. Some assignments may require working at external venues in the Los Angeles area, particularly during setup and live events. Occasional evening or weekend availability will therefore be necessary, with event dates and responsibilities communicated in advance whenever possible.

How To Apply

If you are someone who enjoys organizing details, coordinating people and helping events run according to plan, we welcome your application for the Event Coordinator role in Los Angeles.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**About Kidspace Children's Museum**

For 45 years, Kidspace Children’s Museum has been a welcoming place for exploration and discovery, serving millions of children and their families. Join a team that creates hands-on play and learning experiences that are relevant, joyful, inspiring, and that involve guests in their own process of discovery. Kidspace is an equal opportunity employer and 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization committed to building a culture of play on a foundation of anti-racist policies and practices.

**Position Title: Event and Marketing Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing and Outreach  
**Reports to:** Senior Manager, Marketing and Outreach  
**Status:** Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Position Overview**

The Events and Marketing Specialist leads the planning, coordination, and execution of special events at Kidspace Children's Museum, including private events, community outreach programs, fundraisers, and events developed with community and nonprofit partners. This role manages projects from initial planning through event execution and follow-up, coordinating logistics, budgets, vendors, partners, and internal teams to deliver successful, mission-aligned experiences.

A key focus is connecting Kidspace with children and families who may face barriers to accessing enriching play experiences, including families experiencing financial hardship, children in foster care or facing medical challenges, Title I schools, immigrant and refugee families, and families affected by the Eaton Fire.

The specialist also supports the execution of marketing initiatives across digital, social media, email, advertising, and other communications channels. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, collaborative project manager who can balance multiple priorities, build strong relationships, and turn plans into engaging experiences for children and families.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop event concepts and identify new programming and partnership opportunities.
* Coordinate event promotion and evaluate event outcomes to document results and improve future events.

**Community Outreach and Partnerships**

* Coordinate outreach events and programs that connect Kidspace with children and families who may face barriers to accessing enriching play experiences.
* Build and maintain relationships with nonprofit organizations, schools, healthcare providers, and other community partners.

* Support programs serving families experiencing financial hardship, children in foster care or facing medical challenges, Title I schools, immigrant and refugee families, and families affected by the Eaton Fire.
* Ensure outreach events reflect Kidspace's mission and commitment to joyful, inclusive, and accessible experiences for children and families.

* Organize photography, video, and other creative assets for marketing and event use.
* Monitor marketing performance indicators, compile reports, and identify trends to inform future efforts.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  
  
Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for an Events and Field Marketing Manager to own Sift’s events program, with a primary focus on events that build pipeline. You’ll run Sift’s presence at industry trade shows and conferences, host customer dinners and roundtables, and build community events that bring the hardware engineering community to Sift. You’ll also partner with Talent and Operations on recruiting events. This is a hands-on role with real ownership of a calendar, a budget, and a pipeline target. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and leadership to reach engineers and technical leaders across aerospace, defense, autonomy, and other hardware industries.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own Sift’s annual event calendar and budget, including trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, and speaking submissions, and measure the return on each.
* Plan and run Sift’s presence at industry events end to end, from booth logistics, vendors, and staffing to lead capture and follow-up within 48 hours, using repeatable runbooks and reusable assets.
* Build Sift’s owned event program, including customer dinners, technical roundtables, and a recurring community series in San Francisco and Los Angeles, and capture content from each event to share across Sift’s channels.
* Partner with Sales and RevOps to build target account invite lists, book meetings before each event, and track event-sourced and influenced pipeline so we invest more in what works and cut what doesn’t.
* Partner with Talent and Operations on recruiting events that build candidate pipeline and support Sift’s hiring goals.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 5+ years of experience in field or event marketing at a B2B technology company, with direct ownership of an event calendar, a budget, and a pipeline goal.
* A track record of running trade show booths, executive dinners, and community events end to end, for audiences ranging from executives to engineers.
* Experience partnering with sales teams to turn event engagement into qualified meetings and pipeline, and reporting on results using CRM and marketing automation tools.
* Strong operational discipline and the ability to manage multiple events at once with minimal direction, from contracts and shipping deadlines to vendor invoices.
* Ability to learn a technical product quickly and represent it credibly to engineers and technical leaders.

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience as the first or only field marketer at an early-stage startup, building the program from scratch.
* Experience marketing to engineering audiences in aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, automotive, or energy, including relationships with the major events in these sectors.
* Experience marketing in NDA-constrained environments, where customers often cannot be named publicly.
* Experience running partner and co-marketing programs, including shared booths and co-hosted events.
* Experience running recruiting events or partnering closely with a talent team.

**Location:**
-------------

Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week once every quarter. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $125,000 - $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

Compensation Range: $125K - $175K

Named **Ad Age’s 2025 Multicultural Agency of the Year** and recognized by **PRWeek** for Best in Multicultural Marketing, IW Group produces culture-shaping campaigns for global and national brands.

IW Group drives impactful work by blending storytelling, cultural insight, and innovation to achieve measurable results. We represent multiple brands and deliver distinctive multicultural and cross-generational campaigns.

**Overview**

IW Group is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and creative Social Media Coordinator to support our ongoing social media strategy and execution as we bring this function in-house. The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment, with a passion for social media, digital storytelling, and emerging trends.

In this role, you will help shape IW Group’s voice across multiple platforms, including the IW Group Website, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other channels, to create engaging, platform-specific content that resonates with diverse audiences. You’ll play a key role in translating creative ideas into compelling social content while ensuring our brand voice remains consistent, relevant, and culturally connected.

This role calls for a unique blend of technical understanding, strong copywriting skills, and hands-on creative agility. From staying ahead of the latest social media trends and developing creative briefs to coordinating multimedia content and supporting day-to-day channel management, you’ll help bring our social media presence to life. * 1–2 years’ experience in brand social media, content creation or a similar role.

jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager, ES - NAMER
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  
  
As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.  
  
A day in the life  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
About the team  
Why AWS?  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become  
  
Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, or related discipline, and 2+ years of equivalent work experience

jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Operations Program Manager leads complex, cross-functional programs that enable sales teams to operate more effectively and deliver better client outcomes. A significant focus of the role is managing client portfolio alignment and transfers across large sales organizations, while also supporting broader sales operations priorities, including process improvement, performance insights, and program governance. The role translates business needs into clear plans and requirements, brings together the right partners, drives decisions, and ensures solutions are implemented with discipline and measurable results.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client portfolio program management**

* Lead recurring client portfolio realignment in support of the organization’s business banking client segmentation strategy.
* Oversee the portfolio transfer lifecycle, from client population scoping and data sourcing through approvals, assignments, communications, execution, and post-transfer stabilization.
* Develop and manage integrated plans with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, owners, readiness criteria, and exit criteria for each transfer phase.
* Coordinate business leaders and subject matter experts across sales, data, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, enablement, and technology.
* Oversee the development and validation of transfer populations using agreed inclusion, exclusion, hierarchy, assignment, and ownership rules.
* Partner with data and business teams to reconcile source information, investigate discrepancies, resolve exceptions, and secure required approvals before execution.
* Coordinate transfer files and system updates across applicable platforms, maintaining clear controls, documentation, and contingency plans.
* Develop and coordinate banker readiness activities, including leadership alignment, role clarity, training, job aids, client context, communications, and escalation support.
* Monitor execution and post-transfer issues, drive timely resolution, confirm stabilization, and incorporate lessons learned into future transfer waves.

**Broader sales operations program leadership**

* Manage the intake, evaluation, prioritization, and staging of sales operations requests and enhancements based on business value, risk, effort, capacity, and strategic alignment.
* Lead cross-functional sales operations programs from concept and requirements through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Build program plans, establish governance routines, facilitate decisions, track risks and dependencies, and provide clear status updates to business and executive leaders.
* Design and implement practical process improvements that simplify work, strengthen controls, improve data quality, and create a more consistent experience for bankers and clients.
* Partner with sales leaders and frontline teams to identify operational needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve banker productivity and sales execution.

**Analytics and business insights**

* Define business questions, key performance indicators, measures of success, and reporting requirements for sales programs and operational processes.
* Partner with data and reporting teams to develop dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights for sales and business leaders.
* Analyze performance, adoption, operational trends, exceptions, and root causes to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Translate complex data and findings into clear recommendations, decisions, and actions for leadership.

**Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, process improvement, sales operations, sales enablement, banking operations, or a related client-focused environment.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business teams and partners across data, technology, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, or sales.

  
**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Strong program-management skills, including planning, governance, requirements, issue and risk management, decision tracking, readiness, and implementation.
* Ability to analyze processes and data, identify root causes, develop recommendations, and translate findings into practical business actions.
* Experience gathering business requirements and partnering with technical or data teams through design, testing, implementation, and stabilization.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills, including the ability to create clarity, build alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex information for executives, sales leaders, bankers, and technical partners.
* Strong judgment, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against firm deadlines.

Preferred

* Experience supporting client portfolio transfers, sales coverage changes, segmentation initiatives, or large-scale client or account transitions.
* Experience with sales operations, CRM platforms, workflow tools, reporting solutions, automation, or sales performance programs.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Hogan CIS, Power BI, or comparable customer, account, workflow, and reporting tools.
* Experience with process design, continuous improv

jobs.description:
Job description:

**Join SmartFinancial: Empowering Insurers with Cutting-Edge Technology**

Welcome to SmartFinancial, where our mission is clear: to drive growth and success for insurance agencies through our industry-leading technology! Voted one of the Best Places to Work for four consecutive years, we are one of the fastest-growing tech companies.

We are a leading insurance marketplace, connecting millions of shoppers to our network of insurance partners across all 50 states.

**Why This Role Matters**

As a **Customer Success Manager 1** at SmartFinancial, you’ll play a key role in helping insurance agents and agencies succeed on our platform. You’ll manage a growing book of business, build strong client relationships, and work directly with customers to help them maximize the value and performance of their accounts.

This is a entry-level, in-office role designed for someone who is motivated by building relationships, solving problems, and achieving measurable results. You’ll work with smaller accounts, re-engage customers through our win-back dialer, and identify opportunities to grow accounts to higher monthly spending levels.

CSM1s who consistently meet and exceed performance expectations will be eligible to advance into **Customer Success Manager 2 (CSM2)** or **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** roles.

Our goal is to become the premier Customer Success Team in the Insurtech industry, and you will be an important part of making that happen.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Grow:** Manage a book of **100+ active accounts**, building strong relationships while identifying opportunities to increase account utilization and monthly spend.
* **Win Back:** Work our win-back dialer to re-engage inactive and lower-spending customers, build your book of business, and create new opportunities for account growth.
* **Optimize:** Review lead performance, filters, pricing, geographic targeting, emails, calls, and other account settings to help clients get the most out of the SmartFinancial platform.
* **Drive Results:** Help customers improve key performance indicators such as cost per acquisition, close rate, lead quality, return on investment, and overall account performance.
* **Retain:** Build trusted customer relationships and proactively identify issues that could impact customer satisfaction, utilization, or retention.
* **Own It:** Serve as a reliable point of contact for your assigned customers, providing consistent communication and helping them achieve their business goals.
* **Solve:** Address customer questions, objections, concerns, and ad-related complaints using established Customer Success processes and protocols.
* **Excel:** Deliver a best-in-class customer experience while consistently achieving the activity, retention, talk-time, and account-growth goals associated with the role.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **1–2+ years of experience** in customer service, customer success, sales, account management, or a related client-facing role preferred.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed **KPIs, activity goals, sales targets, or other performance metrics**.
* Experience working with **insurance agencies, insurance technology, lead generation, or marketplace businesses** is highly valued.
* Experience with **high-volume calling** and comfort communicating with customers regularly.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and clearly communicate solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities to improve customer performance.
* Highly motivated, **coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven environment**.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to effectively manage a large book of customer accounts.
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to quickly learn and utilize new software and technology.
* Must be available for **full-time, in-office work**. (6am-3pm) PST

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Base Salary: $70,034**
* **Career Growth:** Start your career as a CSM1 with a clear path toward **CSM2 and Strategic CSM** opportunities for high performers.
* **Training & Development:** Receive extensive product training, coaching, role-play opportunities, and ongoing development to help you become an exceptional Customer Success professional.
* **Performance-Driven:** Your success is measurable. You'll have clear goals and KPIs that allow you to understand exactly what success looks like and how you can continue to grow.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** 401k with company match, along with company-sponsored health, dental, and life insurance plans.
* **Employee Referral Bonus:** Help us grow our team and earn additional rewards through our employee referral program.
* **World-Class Culture:** We believe our people and culture are what make SmartFinancial special.

We’d especially like to highlight our **World Class Culture**, which our employees say is the best thing about working at SmartFinancial. We have great SLACK channels for work and play, which keep you connected with your fellow employees throughout the day. Not to mention our top-notch company events (like our Summer Beach Party with open bar, chili cook-off, annual holiday yacht party, fun office potlucks and more) that will keep you asking when the next event is.

We also have Penny, our company mascot. Like swag themed after a pink pig wearing glasses? Just. You. Wait.

Join SmartFinancial and become a key player in helping insurance agencies grow their businesses. If you're motivated by relationships, results, and career growth, **apply now and let's achieve success together!**

SmartFinancial is an equal opportunity employer, and we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To learn more about our results-focused culture and employee-focused perks, read more on our careers page.

Working in close partnership with the Chief Marketing Officer, global and regional Marketing leaders, Sales leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders, the role ensures that Marketing and Sales operate through aligned processes, clear governance, reliable data, consistent performance measures, and efficient ways of working.
  
  
The role focuses on improving the end-to-end revenue process across Marketing and Sales, including lead management, customer lifecycle management, Marketing-to-Sales handoffs, pipeline governance, reporting, and performance visibility. The Global Revenue Operations Lead identifies opportunities to simplify and standardize processes, reduce manual activities, improve collaboration, and enable scalable execution through appropriate technologies and automation.
  
  
Acting as the primary Business Operations partner to the Marketing and Sales functions, the role supports the design and implementation of scalable operating models, governance frameworks, processes, and business capabilities. This is a highly collaborative individual contributor role requiring strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and the ability to lead change without direct authority in a global and matrixed organization.
  
  
The position requires occasional international travel to engage with regional teams, facilitate workshops, support transformation initiatives, and strengthen alignment across the global Marketing and Sales organizations.

**Job Description**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Operations, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.

* Eight or more years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Business Operations, consulting, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience in process optimization, governance, business transformation, and operational-excellence initiatives.

* Experience working across Marketing and Sales functions and improving alignment throughout the lead-to-opportunity and revenue processes.

* Experience designing or improving lead management, lifecycle management, funnel, pipeline, handoff, and performance-management processes.

* Strong background in KPI definition, data analysis, dashboards, reporting, and business-performance management.

* Experience supporting the implementation and optimization of CRM, Marketing Automation, business intelligence, reporting, or related technology solutions.

* Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

* Experience working with global or multi-regional teams and balancing global standards with regional business requirements.

* Experience translating business requirements into practical process, data, reporting, and technology solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

### **Revenue Operating Model & Process Excellence**

* Define, document, and continuously improve the global Revenue Operations model, processes, roles, and ways of working across Marketing and Sales.

* Establish consistent lead management, lifecycle management, funnel, handoff, pipeline, and customer engagement processes, while accommodating justified regional requirements.

* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate duplication, reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase operational scalability.

### **Governance, Data and Performance Management**

* Establish and maintain governance frameworks, standards, ownership principles, decision rights, and best practices across Marketing and Sales operations.

* Define and align shared definitions, KPIs, reporting standards, dashboards, and performance-management processes across the revenue funnel.

* Promote quality, consistency, accessibility, and appropriate use of Marketing and Sales data to improve performance visibility and support informed decision-making.

### **Technology and Automation Enablement**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, IT, Data and Analytics, and other relevant stakeholders to optimize CRM, Marketing Automation, reporting solutions, and related business processes.

* Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate manual activities, improve data flows, streamline workflows, and increase the effective use of technology.

### **Strategic Partnership & Transformation**

* Act as the primary Business Operations partner to global and regional Marketing and Sales leadership.

* Lead cross-functional operational improvement and transformation initiatives that strengthen Marketing and Sales alignment and improve revenue execution.

* Facilitate stakeholder alignment, manage competing requirements, and drive the adoption of new processes, governance, tools, and ways of working across regions.

**The California Nurses Association (CNA)/National Nurses Organizing Committee (NNOC)/National Nurses United (NNU) is leading the national movement for registered nurse power 225,000 strong to transform the profit-driven health care industry into a health care system based on prioritizing patient care.**

**CNA/NNOC/NNU, the nation's largest union of registered nurses, recognizes that building industrial power and holding employers accountable to nurses' collective bargaining rights are essential to recruiting and retaining Registered Nurses, while protecting their freedom to advocate for patients without fear of retaliation.**

**In California the California Nurses Association passed the first historic Registered Nurse to Patient Safe Staffing law – nurses nationwide understand lives will be changed by safely limiting the number of very sick patients they are responsible for. Safe staffing makes a real difference in patient outcome and a nurse's ability to do the meaningful work they believe in, providing safe patient care.**

**Who We Are**

We are a militant class-conscious trade union building the collective power of working people. We fight for better workplaces, stronger communities, and a society that puts people before profit. We are seeking organizers who are passionate about justice, motivated by collective action, and committed to helping workers build power.

We welcome candidates from labor, community organizing, nonprofits, advocacy organizations, student movements, political campaigns, and other mission-driven backgrounds.

**What We Believe In**

* Class Power: We embrace class-struggle – it is through class-struggle we build worker power to defeat the ruling class. Lasting change happens when workers organize and act collectively to improve their workplaces and communities.
* Transformative Change: We are committed to building a stronger labor movement capable of creating meaningful change for working people.
* Political Engagement: Workers have the power to fight back against all forms of oppression that impact our lives through collective action and democratic participation.

**Who Thrives Here**

* Deeply committed to justice and solidarity
* Strong relationship builders
* Resilient, adaptable, and willing to learn
* Motivated by collective action and worker empowerment
* Comfortable engaging, persuading, and mobilizing others

**Summary**
-----------

**This Program Specialist (HR Liaison) serves regional employees and various Stafford Act Disaster employees across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will have experience coordinating staffing, personnel actions, recruitment, and data management. They will also have experience guiding staff on human resources related policies, and procedures.**

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

This position is announced under FEMA's Excepted Service, Stafford Act Hiring Authority for a full-time Cadre of On-Call Response/Recovery Employee (CORE) appointment. After three years of continuous service, CORE employees earn competitive eligibility to apply for permanent full-time positions at FEMA. Veterans Preference does not apply to the CORE selection process.

  

**Duties**
----------

**What will I do in this position if hired?**

In this Program Specialist position, you will serve a Human Resources Liaison for the Employee Services Branch.
  
  
Typical assignments include:

* **Coordinating staffing, recruitment, employee relations, and personnel actions across disaster workforces.**
* **Maintaining essential Employee Services Branch functions, including employee records management, personnel-status reporting, and organizational chart updates.**
* **Providing assistance, guidance, and training to employees regarding applicable federal policies, regulations, and procedures.**
* **Analyzing human capital data to generate workforce reports, support workforce planning and decision-making, and maintain deployment readiness.**

**What else do I need to know?**

**At FEMA, our mission is to help people before, during and after disasters, and every employee at FEMA has a role in emergency management.** Every FEMA employee has regular and recurring emergency management responsibilities, though not every position requires routine deployment to disaster sites. All positions are subject to recall around the clock for emergency management operations, which may require irregular work hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the employee's official position description. Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and may require employees to relocate to emergency sites with physically austere and operationally challenging conditions.

**This announcement is for a position as a CORE (Cadre of On-Call Response/Recovery Employee).** CORE employees are full-time employees hired to directly support the response and recovery efforts related to disasters. Employees are hired under the Robert T. Stafford Act and are excluded from the provisions of title 5, United States Code, governing jobs in the competitive service. They can be hired under a streamlined process instead of a competitive process. After three years of continuous service, Stafford Act employees may be granted competitive eligibility to apply for permanent full-time positions at FEMA.
  
  
**This position has promotion potential to the IC-0301-12**. Promotions are dependent on your ability to perform the duties at a higher level, successful performance review displaying at least one year of experience at the lower grade, the continuing need for an employee assigned to the higher level, and management approval.

  

**Requirements**

jobs.description:
**Generic Scope:**

Experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems / issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.

  

**Custom Scope:**

The Ambulatory Care Administrative Coordinator 3 serves as a lead administrative resource and operational partner for assigned ambulatory sub-specialty clinics. Under the supervision and direction of departmental administrative leadership, the incumbent applies broad knowledge of ambulatory care clinical and business operations to support effective clinic management, efficient administrative workflows, provider needs, and consistently exceptional patient experience.

  

The incumbent assumes responsibility for the day-to-day administrative coordination and oversight of assigned clinic workflows, serving as a knowledgeable resource and providing guidance and training to new staff and those providing cross-coverage. This includes ensuring staff understand and consistently follow established scheduling practices, administrative procedures, and workflows that appropriately support patient and provider needs.

  

The position requires a proactive and solutions-oriented individual who takes initiative in identifying operational challenges, evaluating existing processes, and recognizing opportunities to improve clinic efficiency, access, and patient experience. The incumbent is expected to independently gather relevant information, assess operational needs, identify potential solutions, and develop recommendations for review by departmental administrative leadership. All proposed changes to established workflows, administrative practices, scheduling processes, or clinic operations must be reviewed and approved by departmental administrative leadership before implementation. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring that decisions and operational changes remain aligned with departmental priorities, leadership direction, and established standards.

  

The incumbent works directly with providers and clinic staff to understand operational needs, monitor clinic flow, address administrative challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement. This includes coordinating and participating in recurring meetings with providers, clinic teams, and departmental administrative leaders to review clinic operations, discuss challenges, evaluate performance, and develop recommendations to improve clinic function and the overall patient experience.

  

The role is responsible for monitoring clinic performance, tracking and evaluating operational metrics, and preparing routine reports and presentations as necessary that communicate clinic activity, identify trends and operational challenges, and support informed decision-making by departmental leadership. The incumbent is expected to translate operational data into meaningful insights that help identify resource needs, access challenges, workflow inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

  

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, accountability, initiative, and the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and competing priorities while working within established departmental guidelines and leadership direction. The incumbent is expected to exercise initiative in day-to-day operational coordination and problem-solving while recognizing when issues, recommendations, or proposed changes require escalation, consultation, and approval from departmental administrative leadership. This position does not have independent authority to establish or implement changes to departmental policies, operational standards, or established clinic workflows without prior leadership review and approval.

  

This is a fully on-site position requiring regular work across multiple clinic locations. The incumbent must demonstrate flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to provide consistent administrative oversight, coordination, and support across assigned sub-specialty clinic locations.

  

**Department Overview**

The Dermatology practices at UCSF Health are regional centers offering a broad spectrum of diagnostic and treatment services for patients of all ages with cutaneous problems. We provide the most comprehensive skin cancer treatment program in northern California. We are the region’s only vascular anomalies center, and we provide a complete psoriasis treatment program.

  

The Dermatology Clinic offers a wide range of treatments for patients across the age continuum with skin problems, including but not limited to the following conditions: acne, autoimmune, connective tissue disease, HIV-related skin disorders, mole, atypical nevus, melanoma surveillance, disorders of cornification, pigmented disorders, environmental dermatitis, rosacea, hair, and nail disorders, and human papillomavirous (HPV). The procedures performed in the Dermatology clinics include biopsies, excisions, mohs surgery, and cosmetic procedures.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  
  
Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for an Events and Field Marketing Manager to own Sift’s events program, with a primary focus on events that build pipeline. You’ll run Sift’s presence at industry trade shows and conferences, host customer dinners and roundtables, and build community events that bring the hardware engineering community to Sift. You’ll also partner with Talent and Operations on recruiting events. This is a hands-on role with real ownership of a calendar, a budget, and a pipeline target. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and leadership to reach engineers and technical leaders across aerospace, defense, autonomy, and other hardware industries.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own Sift’s annual event calendar and budget, including trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, and speaking submissions, and measure the return on each.
* Plan and run Sift’s presence at industry events end to end, from booth logistics, vendors, and staffing to lead capture and follow-up within 48 hours, using repeatable runbooks and reusable assets.
* Build Sift’s owned event program, including customer dinners, technical roundtables, and a recurring community series in San Francisco and Los Angeles, and capture content from each event to share across Sift’s channels.
* Partner with Sales and RevOps to build target account invite lists, book meetings before each event, and track event-sourced and influenced pipeline so we invest more in what works and cut what doesn’t.
* Partner with Talent and Operations on recruiting events that build candidate pipeline and support Sift’s hiring goals.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 5+ years of experience in field or event marketing at a B2B technology company, with direct ownership of an event calendar, a budget, and a pipeline goal.
* A track record of running trade show booths, executive dinners, and community events end to end, for audiences ranging from executives to engineers.
* Experience partnering with sales teams to turn event engagement into qualified meetings and pipeline, and reporting on results using CRM and marketing automation tools.
* Strong operational discipline and the ability to manage multiple events at once with minimal direction, from contracts and shipping deadlines to vendor invoices.
* Ability to learn a technical product quickly and represent it credibly to engineers and technical leaders.

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience as the first or only field marketer at an early-stage startup, building the program from scratch.
* Experience marketing to engineering audiences in aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, automotive, or energy, including relationships with the major events in these sectors.
* Experience marketing in NDA-constrained environments, where customers often cannot be named publicly.
* Experience running partner and co-marketing programs, including shared booths and co-hosted events.
* Experience running recruiting events or partnering closely with a talent team.

**Location:**
-------------

Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week once every quarter. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $125,000 - $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

Compensation Range: $125K - $175K

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
The world needs 3 TW of new solar capacity every year. The legacy approach of developing and building infrastructure is mathematically incapable of catching up.

Planted is the autonomous power deployment company. We transform power plants from bespoke construction projects into manufactured products. By integrating planning software, high-density arrays, energy storage, and field robots, we deliver more power where it's needed most.

The physics are solved; what remains is relentless execution. Led by repeat founders and an engineering core from SpaceX and Tesla, we are backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Piva Capital, Google, Gigascale Capital, Khosla Ventures, and RA Capital Management.

We’re scaling fast and looking for operators and engineers who want to own real pieces of the system. You don't need a traditional energy background; we care whether you can finish hard things. Come build with us.

This is an individual-contributor role in our Finance & Administration team, reporting to our Head of Finance. The salary range for this full-time position is $130,000 - $165,000 plus stock options and benefits. The target experience for the position is 5-10+ years.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Generate and distribute customer invoices via Quickbooks Online
* Apply incoming customer payments and own the A/R aging schedule
* Process bi-weekly payroll for salaried & hourly employees
* Process weekly vendor payments thru banking platform
* Prepare monthly reconciliations of bank and general ledger accounts
* Prepare monthly & quarterly financial statements
* Assist in Federal income tax returns and California Sales & Use tax filings
* Support financial and tax audits as needed
* Coordinate immigration visa applications, supporting applicants and interfacing with immigration attorney

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of experience in general accounting & financial reporting and at least one year of payroll experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Business Administration
* Working familiarity with CDTFA filing requirements and California use tax
* Intermediate Excel capabilities (Vlookup, pivot tables, sumifs)
* Experience with Quickbooks Online
* You communicate complex ideas clearly and succinctly. We don't have time to decode jargon.
* You are relentlessly hands-on. Located in the SF Bay Area (or willing to relocate) and able to work in-person.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with ADP Workforce Now a plus
* Netsuite experience a plus
* CPA license a plus

**PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS**

* Mostly desk work using standard office equipment

**Philosophy On Qualifications And Compensation**
-------------------------------------------------

Many people only apply for jobs if they believe they can perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and will consider equivalent combinations of knowledge, skills, education, and experience. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

Additionally, we believe compensation should reflect the value people bring and give them a real stake in what we're building. Our total compensation package includes a base salary, meaningful equity through stock options, and benefits including company holidays, paid time off (PTO), and in-office lunches. Individual pay may vary within the posted range and is determined by a number of factors including relevant experience, skills, and location.

**How We Work**
---------------

We are using sunlight, software, and robots to power the world. It is historic work, and it is hard work. If you want a paved, predictable path, this isn't for you. If you'd rather invent the path, this is the best job you'll ever have.

* **Call it out.** We put big robots in the field alongside our crews and partners. Anyone can stop any operation at any time. The same trust runs everywhere: a bug in the code, a flaw in the plan, a risk in the dirt, a design that no longer makes sense. Say it while it's small and cheap to fix, directly to the person who can fix it. Sometimes that person is you.
* **Commit and complete.** We work problems, not tasks. A confident guess is not a commitment; “I'll find out by Thursday” is. If a date slips, say it early and bring the new plan. Every decision has one owner: bring data, argue hard, push back in the room, then the owner calls it and we lock arms. Execution compounds.
* **Convention isn't evidence.** “Industry standard” is a red flag. Most conventions were answers to constraints that no longer exist. We respect physics and obey the law. Everything else is a choice, and we get to make it.
* **Let machines do the work.** We are system builders: AI and robots do repetitive work in the field and in the office. Every task a machine takes over is a person out of harm's way or off the critical path. Solve a problem once, then build the tool, write the spec, and commit the doc so nobody has to solve it again. Doing it by hand once is fine. Twice means we need a tool.

Planted is an equal opportunity employer committed to growing inclusively, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, medical condition, age, or veteran status. However you identify, or whatever background you bring with you, please apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

Compensation Range: $130K - $165K

jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Contracts shape how companies win customers, buy technology, work with partners, and manage risk. But reviewing them and finding the answers inside still takes too much expert time—slowing decisions across the business. Ivo is building AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts, apply company standards, and turn agreements into actionable intelligence. Our ambition is bigger than making legal work faster: we're building toward becoming the system of record for how companies work with contracts.

As an Account Manager, you'll own renewals and expansion across a book of Ivo customers, and help them transform how their business works with contracts. We're hiring Account Managers across three segments: **Scaled**, **Mid-Market** and **Enterprise**. The core of the role is the same in every segment. What changes is the number of accounts you manage, the complexity of the buying process, and the seniority of the people you work with.

An account's size today is not the ceiling on what it can become. You'll build relationships beyond the original buyer, find teams whose work depends on contracts, and grow adoption of Ivo's expanding product portfolio—connecting each solution to a real business need. With ARR up sixfold in the last 12 months, there's strong momentum and a playbook still to shape.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Own the commercial health of your book.** Take responsibility for renewals and expansion, with a clear view of each customer's goals, commercial commitments, and growth potential. Decide where to spend your time based on customer need, risk, and opportunity, and move your accounts forward without waiting for a playbook.
* **Create expansion opportunities—not just respond to them.** Look beyond the original buyer and use case. Find teams whose work depends on contracts, understand their problems, and connect the right Ivo product to a real business need. Think beyond today's contract while grounding every proposal in what the customer can use and achieve.
* **Build relationships that create value across the organization.** Earn trust with day-to-day legal users, champions, business leaders, and budget owners. Understand what each stakeholder is trying to achieve, where their priorities intersect, and where they differ. You're not collecting contacts: you're building a network of people who see a meaningful role for Ivo in their business and can work together to make it real.
* **Be deeply analytical about where value is—and where it could be.** Identify and develop strategic growth opportunities. Partner closely with CSMs to understand customer adoption, usage trends, and business priorities. Use these insights to uncover whitespace, build compelling expansion opportunities, and engage the right stakeholders to turn potential into revenue.
* **Turn customer outcomes into a compelling case for investment.** Translate what Ivo helps customers achieve into business terms: less time spent reviewing agreements or finding answers, faster decisions, more consistent standards, and better visibility into contractual commitments and risk. Build credible business cases with clear baselines, explicit assumptions, and outcomes customers can measure. Help champions make the case internally, and lead thoughtful executive conversations about what matters, what needs to change, and why the next investment is worthwhile.
* **Help customers build toward Ivo as their system of record for contracts.** Develop a long-term vision with customers for how Ivo can become central to the way their organization works with contracts—not simply another tool used by one team. Connect that ambition to current capabilities and a practical sequence of use cases across Ivo’s expanding product portfolio. Help customers identify the stakeholders, workflow changes, and internal commitments needed to progress, so better access to contract knowledge positions their teams to move quickly and execute business decisions with confidence.
* **Run disciplined renewal and expansion cycles through close.** Own discovery, proposals, procurement, legal review, negotiation, and close. Build plans with clear next steps and decision owners, surface risk early, and maintain an evidence-based forecast. Maintain accurate forecasts and an up-to-date pipeline, working closely with your manager to ensure clear visibility into renewals and expansion opportunities.
* **Bring Ivo together around the customer.** Partner with CSMs, Solutions Architects, Legal Engineers, Product, and Finance, bringing them in when their expertise will help. Keep commercial ownership clear, stay accountable for follow-through rather than treating a handoff as the finish line, and bring precise customer feedback to Product. Turn what works into repeatable ways to grow your book.

**Skills You'll Need to Bring**
-------------------------------

* A track record of personally creating and closing expansion within existing software customers. You can explain the opportunity you uncovered, what you sold, who you brought into the decision, and the result. ------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers unlock its full potential? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Enterprise Support is looking for a Technical Account Manager to serve as a trusted technical advisor for our enterprise customers. In this role, you will work directly with customers to help them navigate their cloud journey, from migration planning through operational optimization. You will combine deep technical knowledge with strong relationship-building skills to deliver proactive guidance, resolve complex challenges, and ensure customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through AWS. If you are a curious, self-driven problem solver who thrives on making a tangible impact, this is your opportunity to shape how organizations adopt and scale in the cloud.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for one or more enterprise customers, building trusted advisor relationships and providing strategic guidance across the full cloud adoption lifecycle.
* Proactively review customer environments to identify risks, recommend architectural improvements, and promote best practices around security, fault tolerance, performance, cost effectiveness, and operational readiness.
* Lead planned critical enablement events such as product launches, infrastructure migrations, and scaling activities by assessing operational readiness and driving architecture optimizations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional AWS teams—including solutions architects, service engineers, and account managers—to advocate for customer needs, accelerate issue resolution, and surface feature requests to engineering teams.
* Evaluate opportunities to integrate Generative AI and cloud-native solutions into customer strategies, helping them adopt new AWS capabilities that align with their business goals.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might begin with a proactive architecture review for a customer preparing to scale a critical workload, followed by a deep-dive call where you help an engineering team optimize their deployment pipeline. After lunch, you could be coordinating with AWS service teams to resolve an operational issue, then wrapping up by preparing data-driven insights for an upcoming quarterly business review. Throughout it all, you are the connective thread between your customers and the broader AWS ecosystem, turning technical complexity into clear, actionable guidance.  
  
About the team  
AWS Enterprise Support partners with customers across industries to help them get the most from cloud technology. Our team is committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, sales, and professional services teams to deliver an exceptional support experience. We are focused on helping customers build resilient, secure, and cost-effective architectures while preparing them for the next wave of cloud innovation. If you want to grow your technical expertise, mentor peers, and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team culture, we would love to hear from you.

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience

jobs.title: NYC Law Firm - Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Torres & Zheng at Law, P.C.** is a boutique business law firm founded in 2018 and rebranded in 2023. We serve entrepreneurs, businesses, and employers across the U.S. and China, with a strong presence in New York, New Jersey, and Atlanta (business immigration).

Our firm was built by entrepreneurs, for entrepreneurs. We are redefining legal services by breaking away from traditional law firm structures and putting clients at the center of everything we do. Our vision is to create a platform where passionate professionals can build meaningful careers, guided by the Japanese concept of *Ikigai*-doing what you love and what you are good at. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and impact.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Coordinator with **strong video editing skills** to own our short-form video content. Your core job is simple and clear: **each week, you will ideate, film, edit, and publish four videos on Rednote (Xiaohongshu) and Douyin.** You will work directly with our Managing Partner, who serves as the primary on-camera talent, and you will be responsible for turning raw footage into polished, engaging videos that grow our audience and bring in clients.

As the program grows, we will gradually expand to additional platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and WeChat Channels. You will also support the firm with other marketing tasks as needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Core: Weekly Video Production (4 videos/week on Rednote & Douyin)**

* **Ideation:** Brainstorm and pitch timely, relevant topics that resonate with entrepreneurs and business clients in the U.S.–China corridor; write scripts, talking points, and titles
* **Filming:** Set up and run shoots, including camera, lighting, and audio; direct the Managing Partner on camera to get natural, engaging delivery
* **Editing (primary focus):** Independently edit every video from raw footage to final cut, including:
* Tight pacing and cuts optimized for short-form, vertical (9:16) viewing
* Strong hooks in the first 3 seconds
* Accurate Chinese and English subtitles, on-screen text, and graphics
* Background music, sound effects, and audio cleanup
* Basic color correction and visual consistency across the channel
* Covers and thumbnails tailored to each platform
* **Publishing:** Write captions and hashtags, schedule posts, and maintain a consistent weekly content calendar

**Growth & Analytics**

* Study the Rednote and Douyin algorithms and apply best practices to grow views, followers, and engagement
* Track performance data and adjust content strategy based on results
* Monitor how social media activity converts into client inquiries, and propose improvements

**Platform Expansion**

* Help launch and adapt content for additional platforms (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, WeChat Channels, etc.) as the program grows

**Marketing Support**

* Support other marketing tasks as needed, such as event promotion, graphic design for posts and flyers, website or newsletter content, and photography for firm events

**Qualifications**

* **Proven short-form video editing skills.** You must be able to independently edit polished, high-retention videos. Proficiency in CapCut / 剪映, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools
* A portfolio of short-form videos **you personally edited** (Rednote, Douyin, TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts)
* Comfortable with filming, lighting, and audio setup
* **Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required.** You will create content for Chinese-speaking audiences
* Strong understanding of Rednote and Douyin content style, trends, and algorithms; familiarity with U.S. platforms is a plus
* Strong writing skills in both Chinese and English
* Ability to work fast and consistently, delivering four finished videos every week
* Self-starter with strong organizational skills
* 1-2 years of experience in video editing, content creation, social media, or digital marketing (internships and personal/freelance accounts count)
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Film/Video Production, Journalism, or a related field preferred
* In-person availability Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary of **$60,000** per year
* The opportunity to build and own a social media program from the ground up
* Direct mentorship and collaboration with the firm’s Managing Partner
* A creative, entrepreneurial, and supportive team culture rooted in our core values: SCREAM (Service, Client-Centric, Relationships, Empowerment, Accountability, Mastery)
* Real impact, your work will directly contribute to client acquisition and firm growth

**How to Apply**

Please send your resume and a portfolio or video samples to admin@torresbusinesslaw.com with the subject line: "Social Media Coordinator Application - [Your Name]"

Pay: $60,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
