jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator - Beacon
jobs.description:
University Settlement partners with 40,000+ New Yorkers in Lower Manhattan and Brooklyn every year to build on our collective strengths as we achieve healthy, stable, and remarkable lives. For nearly 140 years, we’ve fought poverty and systemic inequality by building highly effective social services in collaboration with our neighbors. Established in 1886 as the first Settlement House in the United States, we bring the values of that movement into the 21st century by meeting New Yorkers where they live, listening deeply to all perspectives, and creating space for responsive cooperation.

Joining with our neighbors to make stable foundations where people of all ages can grow and pursue their dreams, we build community strength. We infuse a commitment to civic engagement, equality, and communal action into each of our programs, which include early childhood education, youth development, healthy aging, mental health and wellness, English classes for adult immigrants, community centers, and the arts.

The Outreach Coordinator ensures effective outreach to hard-to-reach youth and young adults who do not participate in afterschool or community center programs. The outreach function requires a sensitive individual with the skills and personality to forge relationships with youth who are chronically absent or have dropped out of school and persuade them to engage in Beacon programming. The Outreach Coordinator acts as a “credible messenger” with strong community connections, a good grasp of neighborhood dynamics and ability to address conflicts that have potential to undermine community cohesion. They also have the experience, skills and personal qualities to function as mentors to youth and young adults they enroll in the Beacon. Their priority will be to facilitate a respectful relationship between all community members in the East Village/ Lower East Side and increase Beacon evening and weekend program participation.

The Outreach Coordinator will also plan and facilitate community-building and enrichment activities for at-risk youth . Here, the Outreach Coordinator will be responsible for creating dynamic, engaging, experiential programming for Beacon participants. They will work with Beacon Activity Specialists, Group Leaders, and the Beacon Program Director to create activities in the areas of, but not limited to, the Arts; including Performing and Visual, Recreation/Sports, and Community/Team Building. The Outreach Coordinator will also work with other service providers, both internal and external, to create programming that reflects University Settlement’s core values and mission.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist other Activity Specialists with providing general supervision of Beacon office and shared space.
* Provide a welcoming, professional demeanor to participants and visitors to the program.
* Collect basic information pertaining to young people’s needs.
* Plan and facilitate enrichment activities for Wednesday to Friday night programming.
* Facilitate large and small discussion groups and other activities to foster a sense of community.
* Strategize and achieve enrollment goals as specified by Beacon Program Director.
* Ensure youth receive referrals to appropriate University Settlement programs as well as to other community resources.
* Engage in community conversations/networking with other stake holders (i.e. school leadership team, service providers, school safety).
* Maintain all agency reporting requirements and inform supervisor of all program activities and changes.
* Meet weekly with Supervisor for planning and evaluation.
* Participate in agency-wide initiatives as required by supervisor.
* Complete other relevant duties as requested by supervisor.

**Qualifications:**

* Highschool diploma or HSE required. Knowledge of youth issues and/or familiarity working with at-risk, street involved, or LGBT youth population.
* Demonstrated experience with group facilitation.
* Knowledge of youth empowerment philosophy and harm reduction.
* Training in de-escalation/ conflict mediation helpful.
* Ability to apply positive youth development principles.
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries between self and youth.
* Commitment to professionalism and ability to serve as a staff representative of University Settlement.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills required.
* Self-starter able to work independently.

**Work Schedule:** Full time, Monday - Friday, some evening hours, 35 hours per week, Hybrid schedule

*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive community. We support a broadly diverse team that will contribute to our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer for all regardless of race, color, citizenship, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran or reservist status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Content Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Content Production Coordinator**

**About Cypherpunk**

At Cypherpunk Technologies (Cypherpunk), our mission is to advance technologies that guarantee privacy for humans on the internet. As a privacy technology company, Cypherpunk pursues this mission through three primary strategies: mining Zcash through Cypherpunk Mining; accumulating Zcash through open market purchases; and investing in, acquiring, and building technologies that push the frontier of privacy forward.

We are a small, ambitious team focused on building the future of privacy. We believe meaningful progress comes from people who are passionate about the mission, willing to challenge assumptions, and ready to adapt as technology and the industry evolve.

We value individuals who take ownership, move quickly, and turn ideas into results. Collaboration is central to how we operate, and every team member has a direct impact on our success. We encourage thoughtful debate, value different perspectives, and believe the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together.

We're building something important, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. If you're excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving industry, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the role**

Privacy is one of the defining fights of the internet, and most people have never heard the case for it told well. That’s where you come in. As Content Production Coordinator, you’ll run the engine behind Cypherpunk’s long-form content: the videos, podcasts, interviews, and deep dives that explain what we’re building and why it matters. You’ll take every piece from idea to publish, then turn it into clips, threads, and posts built for each platform’s algorithm, so the right people find it and stick around.

You’re terminally online, you know what makes a post hit vs. flop, and you can tell a trend is played out before everyone else does. You’ll back up your instincts with the numbers and make every post hit harder than the last. You’ll own this from day one. Your work will shape how Cypherpunk sounds, looks, and shows up online, for everyone from crypto natives to people thinking about privacy for the first time.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate long-form content from idea to publish: scheduling recordings, prepping guests and hosts, tracking edits, and keeping the content calendar on time
* Cut long-form pieces into clips, threads, and posts tailored to each platform (X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and whatever’s next)
* Write titles, thumbnail briefs, hooks, captions, and descriptions built to perform
* Track what’s working using platform analytics (watch time, retention, CTR, engagement) and use it to shape what we make next
* Keep a pulse on trends, formats, and conversations in crypto, privacy, and tech culture, and bring ideas to the team
* Manage assets, file organization, and publishing workflows so nothing slips
* Work with freelancers (editors, designers) on deliverables and timelines

**What we’re looking for**

* Experience in content, social media, or media production. A channel you’ve grown or work for a creator or brand counts as much as a job title
* Chronically online: you know the platforms, the formats, the memes, and the culture, and you can tell what will land with an audience
* A working understanding of how social media algorithms surface content, and how hooks, retention, posting cadence, and packaging affect reach
* A real appreciation for long-form content (YouTube, podcasts, deep-dive videos) and how to build an audience around it
* Strong organization and follow-through: you can juggle many moving pieces and hit deadlines
* Clear, sharp writing with a feel for voice and tone
* Curiosity about privacy, crypto, and the people building in these spaces (no technical background required)

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on video editing experience (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Descript)
* Experience with thumbnail design or tools like Figma or Canva
* A portfolio, channel, or account you’ve grown, with examples of content that performed
* Familiarity with crypto Twitter, the Zcash community, or privacy and cypherpunk culture
* Experience with podcast production or live streams

Compensation Range: $75K - $125K

jobs.title: Account Manager (NY)
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Contracts shape how companies win customers, buy technology, work with partners, and manage risk. But reviewing them and finding the answers inside still takes too much expert time—slowing decisions across the business. Ivo is building AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts, apply company standards, and turn agreements into actionable intelligence. Our ambition is bigger than making legal work faster: we're building toward becoming the system of record for how companies work with contracts.

As an Account Manager, you'll own renewals and expansion across a book of Ivo customers, and help them transform how their business works with contracts. We're hiring Account Managers across three segments: **Scaled**, **Mid-Market** and **Enterprise**. The core of the role is the same in every segment. What changes is the number of accounts you manage, the complexity of the buying process, and the seniority of the people you work with.

An account's size today is not the ceiling on what it can become. You'll build relationships beyond the original buyer, find teams whose work depends on contracts, and grow adoption of Ivo's expanding product portfolio—connecting each solution to a real business need. With ARR up sixfold in the last 12 months, there's strong momentum and a playbook still to shape.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Own the commercial health of your book.** Take responsibility for renewals and expansion, with a clear view of each customer's goals, commercial commitments, and growth potential. Decide where to spend your time based on customer need, risk, and opportunity, and move your accounts forward without waiting for a playbook.
* **Create expansion opportunities—not just respond to them.** Look beyond the original buyer and use case. Find teams whose work depends on contracts, understand their problems, and connect the right Ivo product to a real business need. Think beyond today's contract while grounding every proposal in what the customer can use and achieve.
* **Build relationships that create value across the organization.** Earn trust with day-to-day legal users, champions, business leaders, and budget owners. Understand what each stakeholder is trying to achieve, where their priorities intersect, and where they differ. You're not collecting contacts: you're building a network of people who see a meaningful role for Ivo in their business and can work together to make it real.
* **Be deeply analytical about where value is—and where it could be.** Identify and develop strategic growth opportunities. Partner closely with CSMs to understand customer adoption, usage trends, and business priorities. Use these insights to uncover whitespace, build compelling expansion opportunities, and engage the right stakeholders to turn potential into revenue.
* **Turn customer outcomes into a compelling case for investment.** Translate what Ivo helps customers achieve into business terms: less time spent reviewing agreements or finding answers, faster decisions, more consistent standards, and better visibility into contractual commitments and risk. Build credible business cases with clear baselines, explicit assumptions, and outcomes customers can measure. Help champions make the case internally, and lead thoughtful executive conversations about what matters, what needs to change, and why the next investment is worthwhile.
* **Help customers build toward Ivo as their system of record for contracts.** Develop a long-term vision with customers for how Ivo can become central to the way their organization works with contracts—not simply another tool used by one team. Connect that ambition to current capabilities and a practical sequence of use cases across Ivo’s expanding product portfolio. Help customers identify the stakeholders, workflow changes, and internal commitments needed to progress, so better access to contract knowledge positions their teams to move quickly and execute business decisions with confidence.
* **Run disciplined renewal and expansion cycles through close.** Own discovery, proposals, procurement, legal review, negotiation, and close. Build plans with clear next steps and decision owners, surface risk early, and maintain an evidence-based forecast. Maintain accurate forecasts and an up-to-date pipeline, working closely with your manager to ensure clear visibility into renewals and expansion opportunities.
* **Bring Ivo together around the customer.** Partner with CSMs, Solutions Architects, Legal Engineers, Product, and Finance, bringing them in when their expertise will help. Keep commercial ownership clear, stay accountable for follow-through rather than treating a handoff as the finish line, and bring precise customer feedback to Product. Turn what works into repeatable ways to grow your book.

**Skills You'll Need to Bring**

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**The opportunity**
===================

As a **BDR**, you’ll be one of the first voices prospective merchants hear from Checkout.com. You’ll help open thoughtful, relevant conversations with businesses, learn what matters to them, and create qualified opportunities for our sales team.

This is a great next step for someone with **1–2 years of BDR experience** who is hungry to grow a career in sales. You’ll work closely with sales partners, build a strong foundation in payments and merchant needs, and have a direct hand in influencing the pipeline. Payments experience is a plus, but it isn’t required-we’re looking for curiosity, commitment, and the drive to learn.

**What success looks like**
===========================

Within your first six months, you’ll have built strong relationships with your sales partners and be fully ramped on the top-of-funnel process. You’ll confidently manage prospecting and meeting booking, handle high-level cold conversations with prospective merchants, and create qualified opportunities that contribute to pipeline.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Research prospective merchants and identify relevant reasons to start a conversation.
* Use phone, email, and other appropriate channels to engage prospects and book qualified meetings.
* Lead professional, high-level cold conversations with senior stakeholders, listen for business priorities, and connect them to a relevant next step.
* Partner closely with sales colleagues to align on target accounts, share context, and make smooth, useful meeting handoffs.
* Keep prospect activity, notes, and next steps organized in our systems, and follow through reliably.
* Build your understanding of payments, Checkout.com’s value, and the internal top-of-funnel process.
* Share what you learn from the market to help the team improve its outreach and prospect engagement.

**What you’ll bring**
=====================

* 1–2 years of BDR/SDR-specific experience, with examples of prospecting and meeting generation.
* Confidence and professionalism on the phone, with the ability to adapt your message and ask thoughtful questions.
* Strong written communication and attention to detail.
* A curious, coachable approach and the discipline to learn, prepare, and follow through.
* A relationship-first mindset: you care about understanding a prospect’s world and bringing useful value to the conversation.
* Resilience and commitment in a goal-oriented role, while maintaining a thoughtful, professional approach.
* Payments or fintech experience is preferred, but not required.
* Ability to work from our New York City location.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Compensation Range: $65K - $80K

NewForm is the creative intelligence company. We help category disruptors like Kalshi, ElevenLabs, and others scale paid ads by turning creative into a measurable, repeatable growth system.

jobs.description:
**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**

Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.

At Adams Clinical, you'll find:

* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity

If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**  
Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network focused on late-phase, industry-sponsored trials for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies.  
  
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator I at our clinical research site located in the Bronx. This role is ideal for early-career coordinators with some prior research exposure, looking to develop hands-on clinical and protocol management experience.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I is responsible for supporting and performing routine clinical research activities under the guidance of a CRC II or CRC III. The CRC I may independently manage lower-complexity trials (e.g., maintenance studies, extension studies) and serves as a secondary coordinator on high-enrolling screening trials. This role represents the first step in assuming ownership and accountability in study execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently coordinate low- to moderate-complexity trials, including scheduling, visit execution, and day-to-day operations.
* Serve as secondary CRC on high-enrolling screening trials, supporting screening, enrollment, and participant follow-up.
* Conduct participant visits per protocol, including medical/psychiatric history collection, vitals, ECGs, phlebotomy, and specimen processing, as trained.
* Prepare and maintain study source documents, lab kits, CRFs, and visit materials.
* Ensure accurate, ALCOA+-compliant documentation of all study procedures and maintain required logs, trackers, and regulatory files.
* Support investigational product (IP) accountability for assigned studies, including receipt, storage, dispensing, reconciliation, temperature monitoring, and documentation under supervision, ensuring compliance with protocol and site SOPs.
* Communicate with participants between visits to maintain engagement and protocol compliance.
* Assist with sponsor communication, monitoring visit preparation, and audit readiness as appropriate.
* Contribute to query resolution, data cleaning, and study metrics tracking to support accurate reporting and inspection readiness.
* Support screening operations and meet enrollment expectations for assigned study tasks.
* Prepare internal reports or summaries for review under guidance from CRC II/III.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in clinical trials required.
* At least 6 months of prior clinical research experience required.
* Experience running clinical trial visits required.
* Currently trained or willing to be trained on phlebotomy.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continue learning hands-on clinical and research skills.

**Pay**: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

**Benefits**:

* 401(k) matching
* Medical, Dental &Vision insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance

  

Adams Clinical is committed to being an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We focus on hiring and nurturing top talent. All employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, transfer, training, discipline, and termination, are made based on the candidate's or employee's qualifications relevant to the position. These decisions are made without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
**Build the future of investment management with us**
-----------------------------------------------------

The infrastructure managing $300 trillion in assets was built in the 90's. Now, all of it is up for grabs. The winner of the AI era of investment management will be a $100B+ company. We intend to be that company.

To get there, we're assembling the most talent‑dense startup in New York. We hire people who are 1) exceptional, 2) allergic to anything that's not exceptional, and 3) recruiters of other exceptional people. We also have no tolerance for brilliant jerks.

We run lean by design. We work with a select group of the largest financial institutions in the world, go incredibly deep with each, and sit in the flow of trillions of dollars. We hire fewer people, ask each to own the outcome, and pay on impact ‑ not tenure or experience.

Moment is not for everyone. The standards are high. The pace is intense and there is no playbook.

In return: the best work of your career, building a generational company.

**About Moment**
----------------

Moment is the AI operating system for investment management, built for the world's largest wealth firms and fintechs. Moment works with firms managing more than $10 trillion in client assets and is backed by Index, a16z, and Lightspeed. Moment was founded by former quants from Citadel and Jane Street and is based in NYC.

**The Role**
------------

The team we build is the company we build, and bringing exceptional people into Moment is our top priority. Most of those people are not looking for a job. How our process runs and feels plays a real role in why they join.

Our standard is a great hotel. What you remember from a great hotel is that everything felt seamless, nothing fell through the cracks, and someone had thought about the small details that made you feel seen and cared for. We want candidates to feel the same way about interviewing with us.

Today that experience runs on a small team and a lot of hustle. We are hiring our first person dedicated to recruiting coordination and operations to help build the function from the ground up.

The job comes in three parts. You run our scheduling and logistics at a very high level. You automate and streamline as much of that as you can, without losing what makes the process feel human. You put the time that frees up into the strategic, tastemaking work behind the hospitality experience we give candidates and interviewers.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Coordinate the process**
--------------------------

Everything about the interviews should feel fast and effortless for candidates and interviewers, even when plans change.

* Learn our interview process for each role end to end, well enough to spot when something is off, fix what is yours to fix, and raise the rest early.
* Own scheduling, travel, and logistics end to end, from first calls to full onsite days, across busy calendars.
* Handle last-minute changes calmly, so it does not become a bad experience for the candidate.
* Keep Ashby accurate, so every candidate has a next step and an owner.

**Own the experience**
----------------------

You are the host from the first email on, well before anyone walks into the office.

* Keep every email and message warm, human, clear, and fast, so candidates always know what is happening next.
* Look for the small things at every stage that make someone feel expected, and make them happen. For example, put "in person" or "virtual" in the invite title so they can tell at a glance, send a packet before the onsite with the backgrounds of everyone they will meet, or find out what they like to eat and have lunch ordered before they arrive.
* Go into each onsite knowing who the candidate is, and own their day from the moment they arrive, including when something ends early or runs long.
* Treat interviewers as customers too. Make it easy for them to show up prepared and to give feedback, and take the logistics off their plate.

**Make it scale**
-----------------

The process should get better and more efficient each quarter, without losing the human touch.

* Find the slow, repetitive, or awkward parts of the process and fix them on your own initiative, using AI, Ashby automations, and whatever else works.
* Help us codify what great looks like for each part of the process, and build it into our systems and templates so it happens every time, even through hyper-growth.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

We care much more about how you operate than about years of experience or specific background. People who do well in this role may have come from recruiting coordination, executive support, office management, customer support, or operations roles. What they have in common:

* **You get the small things right, and people can rely on you.** When you say something will happen, it happens, and no one has to check.
* **You take pride in your work, even the unglamorous parts.** A lot of the work is scheduling and logistics, and you rightfully take pride in treating it as a craft and doing it at an extremely high level.
* **You use good judgment.** Given a goal and partial information, you figure out the rest and make sensible calls.
* **Delighting people is its own reward for you.** You have been this way your whole life, and the people around you would say so.
* **You write well.** Clearly and quickly, in a voice people enjoy hearing from.
* **You look for a better way.** You use AI every day, learn new tools fast, and would rather build something than repeat a task by hand.
* **You are curious about talent.** You want to learn how great teams get built and how to do talent at a world-class level.

**Why join Moment**
-------------------

* **Talent is the top priority here, and we operate that way.** Many companies say it. You will personally see it in your first week.
* **You will own and improve a candidate experience that is working.** Candidates already tell us our process stand

jobs.title: Community Outreach & Strategic Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Love Being Out of the Office & Making Great First Impressions?** If you thrive on meeting new people, building warm connections, and brightening someone’s workday—rather than sitting in a cubicle staring at spreadsheets—this role was made for you.

We are a trusted pediatric and special-needs home nursing agency dedicated to providing compassionate, in-home care across Metro Atlanta. We are looking for an energetic, polished **Community Outreach & Strategic Partnerships Coordinator** to connect local pediatric clinics, therapy centers, and medical offices with healthcare benefits that qualifying families often don't know exist.

**Compensation & Schedule:**

* **Compensation (Full-Time):** $54,000/year guaranteed base + territory growth bonuses (up to $80,000 OTE) *(Part-time compensation pro-rated/structured based on schedule)*
* **Mileage Covered:** Full mileage reimbursement for all field partner visits
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time or Part-Time options available (Monday–Friday daytime hours)
* **Work Setup:** 100% field & home-based with quick virtual/video team check-ins (**no daily office commute**)

**How Your Territory Works (Smart 4-Quadrant Rotation):** Instead of sitting in cross-town Atlanta traffic every day, we divide Metro Atlanta into **four geographic quadrants** (Northeast, Northwest, Southeast, and Southwest). You will focus on **one quadrant per month**, rotating through all four over a 4-month cycle. Start and end your field days directly from home—no driving to an office just to clock in.

**What You’ll Do Every Day:**

* **Be the Face of Our Mission:** Visit pediatric clinics, therapy centers, medical offices, and community organizations to drop off informational materials, business cards, and appreciation treats.
* **Build Warm, Trusted Relationships:** Check in regularly with front-desk coordinators, office managers, and social workers—no high-pressure sales pitches or cold contract closing.
* **Host Brief Lunch-and-Learns:** Deliver friendly 10–15 minute overviews during clinic staff huddles explaining how our skilled nursing services support families with special needs.
* **Track Your Visits:** Log daily clinic visits and notes in a simple mobile app so our team can support your territory growth.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* **Naturally Warm & Outgoing:** Comfortable walking into an office, introducing yourself, and starting genuine conversations.
* **Polished & Professional:** You represent our pediatric nursing team with warmth, reliability, and professionalism.
* **Self-Motivated & Independent:** Able to manage your own daily route and stay productive in the field without micromanagement.
* **Reliable Transportation:** Valid driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and active auto insurance required.
* **Background:** Experience in healthcare outreach, brand ambassadorship, hospitality, retail management, or field marketing is a plus—but personality, consistency, and heart matter most!

**How to Apply:** Click **Apply Now** with your resume—no lengthy cover letter required. Qualified candidates will be invited for a brief introductory phone chat with our team to discuss the territory, schedule options, and next steps!

Pay: $54,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* This field role rotates monthly across four Metro Atlanta quadrants and requires a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license. Are you comfortable with daily local driving (mileage reimbursed)?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 100% (Required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: National Account Manager,- Retail (US Remote)
jobs.description:
**Why Tosca?**
--------------

At Tosca, we’re redefining supply chains by delivering innovative solutions that drive sustainability, efficiency, and performance. As a leader in reusable packaging, we thrive on collaboration, transparency, and doing the right thing. Here, your work will matter. You’ll lead change, drive impact, and shape the future of how products move through global supply chains. Join a team where your voice is heard, your ideas have power, and your career can grow.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

As the National Account Manager – Retail, you will lead efforts to transform retail supply chains by driving the shift from traditional corrugated packaging to Tosca’s sustainable Reusable Plastic Containers (RPCs). A key focus of this role will be generating new business by identifying, developing, and securing new retail partners, particularly within the grocery and club channels, across North America. You’ll develop and strengthen relationships with key retail partners, from the C-suite to distribution centers, serving as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.

In this high-impact role, you will influence decision-makers, uncover growth opportunities, and drive adoption of RPCs across complex retail networks. You’ll manage and expand strategic accounts, prospect and develop new retailer relationships, lead new business initiatives, and collaborate across multiple departments to deliver solutions that generate long-term value.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify, develop, and secure new retail business opportunities across North America, with a focus on grocery and club retailers, driving new partners toward adoption of Tosca’s Reusable Plastic Containers (RPCs).
* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and existing retail partners, building strong relationships across functions and levels, from distribution centers to corporate leadership.
* Influence retailers to adopt Tosca’s Reusable Plastic Containers (RPCs) by demonstrating the value of sustainable packaging across their supply chain.
* Partner closely with Tosca’s Protein, Produce, Egg, and New Business Development teams to support supplier engagement and ensure alignment with retailers.
* Lead initial RFP efforts and ongoing contract maintenance negotiations to maximize EBITDA.
* Secure trials and manage pilots with new and existing retail partners that demonstrate RPC impact on efficiency, sustainability, and overall supply chain value.
* Support the conversion of goods shipped to retailers from traditional single-use packaging to Tosca’s RPCs, ensuring buy-in from both retailer and supplier partners.
* Build and maintain detailed account plans for retail partners, aligning strategies with revenue goals and Tosca’s sustainability mission.
* Conduct supply chain and cost analyses to build compelling value propositions and support decision-making at the retail level.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline of new retailer prospects and growth opportunities, ensuring continuous progress from initial engagement through trials, adoption, and expansion.
* Travel as needed to meet with retail stakeholders, support pilot programs, and drive in-person engagement.

**What We Are Looking For:**
----------------------------

-------------------

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**Global Operations Specialist**
--------------------------------

**Help our customers improve their global supply chains**

**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

At Flexport, we know global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global trade easier for everyone. Flexport today connects more than 10,000 clients, both consignees and shippers, across 112 countries. Our role is to help businesses of all sizes find the global trade solutions that will empower their success.

Now more than ever, customers need our support to survive and win in 2026. Their success is our success. We work back from what's best for them to find a solution. That's why we are building the Platform for Global trade - a strategic model combining customer centricity, supply chain expertise, advanced technology, and data analytics.

As a Global Operations Specialist, you are responsible for executing the shipment lifecycle for Ocean & Air shipments, ensuring data integrity is maintained at the highest standard, and proactively minimizing delays with urgency.

As a new team member in our North American Operations group, you'll begin by immersing yourself in our company culture and mastering world-class operations. As Flexport continues to grow, there could be opportunities for future Flexporters to become founding team members in new markets, relocate internationally, and help us expand our presence around the world. If you're interested in a fast-paced career with the potential for international experience, this opportunity could offer you unmatched growth and adventure.

**You will:**
-------------

* Be responsible for executing the movement of ocean and air freight shipments from booking at origin to final delivery at destination.
* Maintain communications with Flexport transportation and warehousing partners to facilitate the progress of shipments in transit.
* Work and communicate cross-functionally within Flexport
* Be a part of the frontline groups ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on time and exceptions are handled appropriately.
* Use metrics to spot opportunities to improve and deliver great performance in your role.
* Own the data quality of our client's information by validating booked shipments, tracking client shipment status, and validating shipment schedules.
* Consistently follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure that your work satisfies internal Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service-Level Agreements (SLAs) in line with productivity goals.

**You should have:**
--------------------

* Bachelor's/Associate's degree OR 1+ year of relevant experience preferred. New graduates are encouraged to apply!
* Team-centric mindset: obsessed with team outcomes, doing what it takes to deliver the team's and their client's expectations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail in a high-energy, fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in Google Suite/Microsoft Suite (Sheets/Excel).
* Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
* A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

#LI-onsite

* Bachelor’s degree minimum required

jobs.title: Freight Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**
----------------

The Dock Master is responsible for coordinating and overseeing daily dock operations to ensure the safe, efficient, and cost-effective movement of freight through the Office Campus. This role coordinates dock activities, staffing, planning, schedules, equipment utilization, and operational priorities while ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, safety requirements, and applicable regulations.

The Dock Master is accountable for meeting assigned operational KPIs, maintaining a safe, tidy, and productive dock environment, supporting employee training and development, and ensuring accurate and timely completion of dock documentation and customer communications. The position requires strong planning, communication, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------

None

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Coordinate daily dock operations to support safe, efficient, and cost-effective freight movements.
* Assist with dock setup, staffing coordination, work schedules, and operational priorities.
* Monitor dock activity and adjust schedules as needed to support productivity and service requirements.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe LTL dock operation in compliance with Company policies, procedures, safety rules, and applicable regulations.
* Support assigned Service Center Business Plan objectives and operational KPIs.
* Utilize Company technology, systems, tools, and processes to support productivity and operational performance.
* Coordinate the assignment and movement of trailers, tractors, and other equipment with supervisors and management.
* Maintain timely and accurate customer communications and dock-related documentation.
* Monitor dock operations and identify opportunities to improve productivity, service, safety, and cost performance.
* Work collaboratively with Service Center management and other departments to resolve operational issues and maintain an efficient flow of freight and equipment.
* Support dock operations during periods of high volume, changing priorities, staffing challenges, and other operational demands.
* Maintain regular attendance and punctuality and perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Experience/Skills:**
-------------------------------

*Education/Work Experience/Certificates*

* High school diploma or GED required.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in transportation, logistics, LTL freight, warehouse, distribution, or dock operations preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word, and the ability to learn transportation, warehouse, and operational management systems.
* 1 Year Forklift Experience
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record, if driving is required as part of the position.

**Skills**

* Dock and freight operations
* LTL transportation operations
* Staff coordination and scheduling
* Daily operational planning
* Workflow and workload management
* Freight movement coordination
* Trailer and equipment coordination
* Forklift and material-handling equipment awareness
* Safety compliance and hazard prevention
* OSHA and transportation regulatory compliance
* KPI and productivity monitoring
* Operational problem-solving
* Process improvement
* Customer service and communication
* Cross-functional team collaboration
* Employee training and development
* Documentation and recordkeeping
* Computer and operational systems proficiency
* Time management and prioritization
* Organization and attention to detail
* Ability to work in high-volume, fast-paced environments
* Ability to adapt to changing operational priorities
* Leadership and team coordination
* Conflict resolution
* Decision-making and critical thinking
* Knowledge of SC Logic a plus

**Physical Requirements:**
--------------------------

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods while monitoring dock operations.
* Ability to move throughout the dock, warehouse, and service center, including navigating around freight, trailers, and equipment.
* Ability to bend, stoop, reach, climb stairs, and maneuver in an active dock environment as needed.
* Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull light-to-moderate materials or equipment as required during dock operations.
* Ability to work in a physically demanding, high-volume environment with exposure to varying temperatures, noise, and moving vehicles/equipment.

* A genuine interest in **customer service, wellness, and helping people**

* Motivation to work toward individual and team goals
* Strong organization and attention to detail
* Reliability and a team-first attitude
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, retail, or another client-facing role is preferred but not required
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends as needed

**Grow With MassageLuXe**

This is more than checking clients in and answering phones. You’ll help shape the client experience, build relationships, and introduce people to services that can make wellness and self-care a regular part of their lives.

If you’re ready to combine **great hospitality with confident sales and customer service**, apply today and grow with MassageLuXe.  
  
**What’s in It for You?**

* **Earning opportunity:** Hourly pay with opportunities to earn additional commissions or incentives based on spa offerings and performance
* **Flexible scheduling:** Full-time and part-time opportunities may be available
* **Employee perks:** Discounts on spa services and retail products
* **Training and development:** Learn our services, memberships, sales approach, and systems with support from your team

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
It is inspiring to work in an organization where individuals are deeply committed to the mission and values that drive our success.
  
  
We are dedicated to delivering expert pension service to Illinois public educators as they earn their promised retirement security.

Under the supervision of the Member Services Outreach Manager, the Outreach Coordinator is responsible for assisting with the planning, development, execution, and evaluation of a comprehensive member education and engagement program designed to enhance the knowledge and understanding of TRS benefits and retirement security in alignment with TRS organizational goals. This position works closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Counseling, Communications, Deferred Compensation, Supplemental Savings Plan Education Specialists, and Employer Services, to support coordinated messaging related to TRS’s mission and vision, TRS benefits, and legislation affecting the System.
  
  
This position requires strong organization, planning, and communication skills and the ability to effectively articulate TRS’s mission, vision, statutory requirements, and retirement benefits. The incumbent must be able to work independently, prioritize and follow through on assignments, and effectively support multiple outreach activities. The incumbent must develop a working knowledge of the Pension Code, Administrative Rules, TRS rules and procedures, and benefits provided through the Teachers’ Retirement Insurance Program (TRIP) and the State of Illinois Group Insurance Program.

**Essential Functions:**

* Assist with the planning, development, execution, and evaluation of member education and outreach programs, including field education, webinars, and other initiatives designed to increase member understanding of TRS benefits and retirement security.
* Deliver presentations and educational programs to members, employers, stakeholder organizations, and other audiences on topics including TRS benefits, retirement security, the Supplemental Savings Plan, legislation, and other System-related topics.
* Assist with the development and coordination of the annual field education schedule and respond to presentation and outreach opportunities.
* Develop and maintain relationships with school districts, teacher organizations, annuitant organizations, school management organizations, and other stakeholders to support educational outreach and engagement.
* Assist with assessing audience and stakeholder needs and tailoring presentations, messaging, and educational resources accordingly.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners, including Counseling, Communications, Deferred Compensation, Supplemental Savings Plan Education Representatives, and Employer Services, to support consistent and coordinated member messaging.
* Assist with evaluating outreach activities through surveys, feedback, participation information, and other measures and communicate opportunities for improvement to the Senior Outreach Coordinator and Member Services Outreach Manager.
* Assist with the development, review, and maintenance of outreach materials, presentations, webinars, and other educational resources.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the Pension Code, Administrative Rules, TRS rules and procedures, TRIP, the State of Illinois Group Insurance Program, legislative activities, and related federal and state programs affecting TRS members.
* Communicate member issues, concerns, and trends to TRS staff and management and provide feedback regarding member and stakeholder needs.
Performs other duties as assigned  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Possesses a high degree of initiative
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Demonstrates a high commitment to quality
* Develops and delivers effective presentations
* Ability to positively represent the organization with external constituents
Ability to organize, prioritize, and follow through on multiple assignments  

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in communication, marketing, public relations, finance education or a related field
* Three (3) year of experiences as a Benefits Counselor or equivalent experience preferred
* This position requires a valid driver's license
* Travel and evening work is required

If you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy collaborating with driven, enthusiastic professionals, you will find a rewarding career with us.

For Illinois job seekers:

**Pay Range**

$77,444.00 - $120,812.00

Compensation will be determined based on the qualifications and experience of each candidate.
  
  
**Benefits**  
TRS is an agency of the State of Illinois. As such, full and part-time employees are eligible for the State of Illinois comprehensive benefits program which includes medical, dental and vision coverage. All employees participate in the TRS retirement pension plan and have the option to contribute to additional State of Illinois deferred compensation plans. The TRS pension plan is a reciprocal system to other state and local pension plans (SERS, SURS, IMRF, etc.)

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Please note:** A cover letter is required for this application.

**Overview:**

The Development Coordinator serves a critical role within The Americas Architecture Prize and reports directly to the Director of MCHAP. This team member leads and supports the organization’s revenue generation and network of supporters, allies, partners, and participants. The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of and appreciation for the broader architectural field; has a passion for not-for-profit development; is motivated, self-directed, and detail oriented; and works well with others in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

**About Us:**

The Americas Architecture Prize is a newly established 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization that operates the Mies Crown Hall Americas Prize (MCHAP) and related programs, an internationally renowned initiative launched nearly 15 years ago at the Illinois Institute of Technology College of Architecture (now College of Design Futures School of Architecture) in Chicago, Illinois. The new organization establishes autonomous governance of MCHAP, supports sustainable and effective operations, and enables a greater hemispheric exchange. The Americas Architecture Prize maintains a close and mutually beneficial partnership with IIT.

The Americas Architecture Prize annually will have a $750,000 operating budget and a $500,000 fundraising goal.

The Americas Architecture Prize seeks to improve the built environment by highlighting, disseminating, and teaching lessons-learned through observation of new outstanding built projects and their innovative design and construction practices in the Americas. The Americas Architecture Prize researches, selects, and educates about the most distinguished newly built works of architecture in the North and South American continents, including buildings, infrastructure, landscape, and urbanism; seeks to build an international platform that engages students, academics, and professionals making decisions affecting our built world across a diversity of interrelated fields, including design, engineering, construction, finance, public policy, and more; and rewards daring solutions to the pressing challenges of our built environment and awards two biennial prizes – the MCHAP Americas Prize and the MCHAP for Emerging Practice.

The Americas Architecture Prize relies on an international network of esteemed nominators and jurors, corporate sponsors and individual donors, and partner organizations to operate and provide a diverse offering of programming to students, faculty, professionals, and communities throughout the Americas.

**Responsibilities:**

*FUNDRAISING & DEVELOPMENT*

* Establish annual fundraising goals with the Director and Board of Directors. This will include individual, Board, corporate, foundation, government, and special event-based funding opportunities.
* Execute the plan to achieve the goals.
* Develop and keep current the databases of past, current, and potential supporters.
* Cultivate new relationships for potential funding opportunities and build a pipeline of potential donors (individual, corporate, foundation, etc.).
* Develop fundraising proposals, grant applications, and other supporting materials.
* Assist in planning and executing benefit dinners and other funding events.
* Oversee fundraising for special projects, such as video production and publications.
* Support the Director and Board in making fundraising asks.
* Process gifts made directly to the organization, manage donor records, and prepare gift acknowledgments in accordance with accounting standards and best practices.
* Coordinate with Illinois Institute of Technology regarding gifts received through them and opportunities for joint overtures to potential funders.

*RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT*

* Assist in maintaining an accurate and updated network contact database (Copper).
* Manage communications with existing donor, sponsor, and patron relationships and MCHAP participants (e.g., current and past jurors, nominators, nominees, and others).
* Serve as liaison to The Americas Architecture Prize Board of Directors.

**Expectations:**

The Development Coordinator commits to working alongside the entire The Americas Architecture Prize team to support its success. Given the nature of the 2-year prize cycle, including evening or weekend activities, working hours will occasionally be outside a standard 9 to 5 schedule and require flexibility (with ample notice). The individual must be based in the Chicago area, though work-from-home scheduling is available upon approval and coordination with the Director. All organization staff are expected to support and work all events, unless otherwise approved.

**Qualifications:**

*EDUCATION*

* Bachelor’s degree in Nonprofit Management or related field is preferred

*EXPERIENCE*

* Minimum of 3 years of professional work experience in fundraising or nonprofit administration

*PREFERRED TECHNICAL SKILLS*

* Proficiency in donor management software (Copper)
* Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English
* Strong understanding of budget development and management
* Familiarity with grant writing
* Familiarity with event management

*SOFT SKILLS*

* Detail oriented, self-directed, and a team player
* Passion for development and fundraising
* Strong project management skills
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment
* Exceptional interpersonal and networking skills
* Passion for international exchange, especially across the Americas

*ADDITIONAL ASSETS*

* Intermediate written and verbal proficiency in Spanish, French, and/or Portuguese

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Our mission at FHLBank Chicago: To partner with our members in Illinois and Wisconsin to provide them competitively priced funding, a reasonable return on their investment, and support for their community investment activities.

Simply said, we're a bank for banks and other financial institutions, focused on being a strategic partner for our members and working together to reinvest in our communities, from urban centers to rural areas. Created by Congress in 1932, FHLBank Chicago is one of 11 Federal Home Loan Banks, government sponsored in support of mortgage lending and community investment.

At FHLBank Chicago, we bring people together. We are committed to a high performing, engaged workforce, and to supporting the communities we serve across Illinois and Wisconsin. Our Buddy Program pairs new hires with tenured employees to guide their onboarding. This role will be responsible for ensuring compliance with federal regulations and program policies as well as performing a key customer success role supporting operational processes for grants awarded through the Bank’s Affordable Housing Program (AHP) General Fund Community Investment program. The Operations Specialist will assist in optimizing processes, developing tools to streamline existing processes, and building reports.

* Support creation of new housing units and support of local organizations district-wide through review of and lifecycle support for AHP projects.

* Provide quality customer service and technical assistance to program users, including guidance for submitting requests, supporting documentation, and ongoing certifications and/or reporting
* Perform comprehensive analysis of multi-family rental and owner-occupied projects for regulatory and programmatic compliance during the full AHP application lifecycle

As an agency, we exist to accelerate growth—for our clients, our people and the B2B industry. We partner with B2B technology and services companies, from high-growth Silicon Valley businesses to global Fortune 500 brands, to drive meaningful business results. We're looking for a Social Media Manager to join our Strategic Communications team and help clients build stronger brands, engage their audiences and drive meaningful business outcomes through social media.

In this role, you'll lead organic social strategy and execution for a portfolio of B2B clients, developing content plans, guiding creative development, managing social channels, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations. You'll work closely with account teams, strategists, copywriters, and designers to deliver thoughtful, creative social programs that connect with the audiences our clients want to reach.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong execution, brings fresh ideas to the table, and understands how social media shapes brand perception, credibility, and business growth.

**What You Will Do (Responsibilities):**

**Social Strategy + Client Management**

* Lead organic social media strategy and execution for a portfolio of B2B clients, aligning channel priorities, content and KPIs with business objectives.
* Develop editorial calendars, content themes, and campaign plans that engage priority audiences and support broader marketing initiatives.
* Serve as a day-to-day social media lead, participating in client meetings and presenting strategic recommendations and performance insights.
* Develop and support executive thought leadership programs, including LinkedIn content strategy, content planning, and executive profile management.

**Content + Creative Development**

* Partner with copywriters, designers, and other creative resources to develop compelling, platform-native content across formats.
* Lead content planning and provide creative direction, feedback, and quality control to ensure content is engaging, differentiated, and aligned with brand messaging.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose existing content, campaigns, and thought leadership into effective social content.

**Channel Management + Community Engagement**

* Oversee content publishing, channel management, and ongoing optimization across platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit, and YouTube.
* Support community management and proactive engagement strategies that help brands participate in relevant conversations and strengthen audience relationships.
* Monitor platform trends, audience behavior, and emerging opportunities to inform content and channel recommendations.

**Measurement + Optimization**

* Establish and track social media KPIs using tools such as Sprout Social, Sprinklr, and native platform analytics.
* Analyze content and channel performance, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Identify opportunities to test new content formats, messaging, and tactics to improve engagement and business impact.

**Integrated Campaigns + Influencer Collaboration**

* Collaborate with PR, creative, paid media, and account teams to integrate organic social into broader marketing campaigns.
* Support creator and influencer marketing initiatives by identifying opportunities to amplify creator content, coordinate messaging and integrate partnerships into owned social channels.
* Contribute to social strategies for product launches, events, executive visibility and other priority campaigns.

**What You Bring (Requirements):**

* 4+ years of experience developing and executing social media strategies, ideally within a B2B agency environment.
* Experience managing multiple social media programs, including content planning, channel management, reporting, and client communication.
* Strong understanding of major social platforms and how to adapt content and strategy for different audiences.
* Experience developing executive thought leadership content and managing executive social profiles.
* Ability to guide creative development and provide thoughtful feedback on social copy, graphics, and video.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate performance data into meaningful recommendations.
* Excellent writing, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Operations Program Manager leads complex, cross-functional programs that enable sales teams to operate more effectively and deliver better client outcomes. A significant focus of the role is managing client portfolio alignment and transfers across large sales organizations, while also supporting broader sales operations priorities, including process improvement, performance insights, and program governance. The role translates business needs into clear plans and requirements, brings together the right partners, drives decisions, and ensures solutions are implemented with discipline and measurable results.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client portfolio program management**

* Lead recurring client portfolio realignment in support of the organization’s business banking client segmentation strategy.
* Oversee the portfolio transfer lifecycle, from client population scoping and data sourcing through approvals, assignments, communications, execution, and post-transfer stabilization.
* Develop and manage integrated plans with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, owners, readiness criteria, and exit criteria for each transfer phase.
* Coordinate business leaders and subject matter experts across sales, data, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, enablement, and technology.
* Oversee the development and validation of transfer populations using agreed inclusion, exclusion, hierarchy, assignment, and ownership rules.
* Partner with data and business teams to reconcile source information, investigate discrepancies, resolve exceptions, and secure required approvals before execution.
* Coordinate transfer files and system updates across applicable platforms, maintaining clear controls, documentation, and contingency plans.
* Develop and coordinate banker readiness activities, including leadership alignment, role clarity, training, job aids, client context, communications, and escalation support.
* Monitor execution and post-transfer issues, drive timely resolution, confirm stabilization, and incorporate lessons learned into future transfer waves.

**Broader sales operations program leadership**

* Manage the intake, evaluation, prioritization, and staging of sales operations requests and enhancements based on business value, risk, effort, capacity, and strategic alignment.
* Lead cross-functional sales operations programs from concept and requirements through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Build program plans, establish governance routines, facilitate decisions, track risks and dependencies, and provide clear status updates to business and executive leaders.
* Design and implement practical process improvements that simplify work, strengthen controls, improve data quality, and create a more consistent experience for bankers and clients.
* Partner with sales leaders and frontline teams to identify operational needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve banker productivity and sales execution.

**Analytics and business insights**

* Define business questions, key performance indicators, measures of success, and reporting requirements for sales programs and operational processes.
* Partner with data and reporting teams to develop dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights for sales and business leaders.
* Analyze performance, adoption, operational trends, exceptions, and root causes to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Translate complex data and findings into clear recommendations, decisions, and actions for leadership.

**Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, process improvement, sales operations, sales enablement, banking operations, or a related client-focused environment.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business teams and partners across data, technology, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, or sales.

  
**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Strong program-management skills, including planning, governance, requirements, issue and risk management, decision tracking, readiness, and implementation.
* Ability to analyze processes and data, identify root causes, develop recommendations, and translate findings into practical business actions.
* Experience gathering business requirements and partnering with technical or data teams through design, testing, implementation, and stabilization.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills, including the ability to create clarity, build alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex information for executives, sales leaders, bankers, and technical partners.
* Strong judgment, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against firm deadlines.

Preferred

* Experience supporting client portfolio transfers, sales coverage changes, segmentation initiatives, or large-scale client or account transitions.

new_jobs.description:
Job description:

**Join SmartFinancial: Empowering Insurers with Cutting-Edge Technology**

Welcome to SmartFinancial, where our mission is clear: to drive growth and success for insurance agencies through our industry-leading technology! Voted one of the Best Places to Work for four consecutive years, we are one of the fastest-growing tech companies.

We are a leading insurance marketplace, connecting millions of shoppers to our network of insurance partners across all 50 states.

**Why This Role Matters**

As a **Customer Success Manager 1** at SmartFinancial, you’ll play a key role in helping insurance agents and agencies succeed on our platform. You’ll manage a growing book of business, build strong client relationships, and work directly with customers to help them maximize the value and performance of their accounts.

This is a entry-level, in-office role designed for someone who is motivated by building relationships, solving problems, and achieving measurable results. You’ll work with smaller accounts, re-engage customers through our win-back dialer, and identify opportunities to grow accounts to higher monthly spending levels.

CSM1s who consistently meet and exceed performance expectations will be eligible to advance into **Customer Success Manager 2 (CSM2)** or **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** roles.

Our goal is to become the premier Customer Success Team in the Insurtech industry, and you will be an important part of making that happen.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Grow:** Manage a book of **100+ active accounts**, building strong relationships while identifying opportunities to increase account utilization and monthly spend.
* **Win Back:** Work our win-back dialer to re-engage inactive and lower-spending customers, build your book of business, and create new opportunities for account growth.
* **Optimize:** Review lead performance, filters, pricing, geographic targeting, emails, calls, and other account settings to help clients get the most out of the SmartFinancial platform.
* **Drive Results:** Help customers improve key performance indicators such as cost per acquisition, close rate, lead quality, return on investment, and overall account performance.
* **Retain:** Build trusted customer relationships and proactively identify issues that could impact customer satisfaction, utilization, or retention.
* **Own It:** Serve as a reliable point of contact for your assigned customers, providing consistent communication and helping them achieve their business goals.
* **Solve:** Address customer questions, objections, concerns, and ad-related complaints using established Customer Success processes and protocols.
* **Excel:** Deliver a best-in-class customer experience while consistently achieving the activity, retention, talk-time, and account-growth goals associated with the role.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **1–2+ years of experience** in customer service, customer success, sales, account management, or a related client-facing role preferred.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed **KPIs, activity goals, sales targets, or other performance metrics**.
* Experience working with **insurance agencies, insurance technology, lead generation, or marketplace businesses** is highly valued.
* Experience with **high-volume calling** and comfort communicating with customers regularly.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and clearly communicate solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities to improve customer performance.
* Highly motivated, **coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven environment**.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to effectively manage a large book of customer accounts.
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to quickly learn and utilize new software and technology.
* Must be available for **full-time, in-office work**. (6am-3pm) PST

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Base Salary: $70,034**
* **Career Growth:** Start your career as a CSM1 with a clear path toward **CSM2 and Strategic CSM** opportunities for high performers.
* **Training & Development:** Receive extensive product training, coaching, role-play opportunities, and ongoing development to help you become an exceptional Customer Success professional.
* **Performance-Driven:** Your success is measurable. You'll have clear goals and KPIs that allow you to understand exactly what success looks like and how you can continue to grow.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** 401k with company match, along with company-sponsored health, dental, and life insurance plans.
* **Employee Referral Bonus:** Help us grow our team and earn additional rewards through our employee referral program.
* **World-Class Culture:** We believe our people and culture are what make SmartFinancial special.

We’d especially like to highlight our **World Class Culture**, which our employees say is the best thing about working at SmartFinancial. We have great SLACK channels for work and play, which keep you connected with your fellow employees throughout the day. Not to mention our top-notch company events (like our Summer Beach Party with open bar, chili cook-off, annual holiday yacht party, fun office potlucks and more) that will keep you asking when the next event is.

We also have Penny, our company mascot. Like swag themed after a pink pig wearing glasses? Just. You. Wait.

Join SmartFinancial and become a key player in helping insurance agencies grow their businesses. If you're motivated by relationships, results, and career growth, **apply now and let's achieve success together!**

SmartFinancial is an equal opportunity employer, and we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To learn more about our results-focused culture and employee-focused perks, read more on our careers page.
